title: SceneProperties — incremental contract for spec #258
description: JSON Schema fragment showing the additive change to SceneProperties contributed by feature #258. The final generated schema (emitted from storyboard.yaml by gen-json-schema) will subsume this; this file is the authoritative human-readable contract for the slot added by this feature.

display_mode.title: Time-controller display mode at capture time
display_mode.description: Captured value of the session-state Zustand store's displayMode at the moment the scene was created. On playback, the host calls session.setDisplayMode(display_mode) as part of executeTransition (alongside flyToViewport). The slot is OPTIONAL to permit legacy scenes (pre-#258) to load without modification; the reader leaves the time-controller untouched when the slot is absent.

x-debrief-contract.writer_invariant: display_mode === session.getState().displayMode at the moment of createScene
x-debrief-contract.reader_invariant_absent: executeTransition MUST NOT change the current displayMode and MUST NOT raise
